summary:
Echoes of Exploration is an interactive educational website that makes space exploration easier and more engaging for students and curious learners. It allows users to explore important space missions, discover historical milestones, investigate scientific mysteries, test their knowledge through quizzes, and solve space-related challenges.

The platform combines interactive learning activities, mission timelines, educational information, and progress tracking in one place. Its goal is to make complex space science concepts more accessible, encourage curiosity, and inspire the next generation to explore the universe.
details:
Project Details – ECHOES OF EXPLORATION

What does the project do?

Echoes of Exploration is an interactive educational website that helps students and space enthusiasts learn about space exploration through engaging activities. Users can explore Moon, Mars, and deep-space missions, discover important historical events through an interactive timeline, investigate scientific mysteries in Detective Mode, answer quizzes, and solve space-related challenges.

How does it work?

The website is organized into different learning sections. Users can navigate between mission explorers, timelines, detective cases, quizzes, problem-solving scenarios, mission challenges, and a learning center containing space-related information and definitions. A progress section tracks learning activities and awards badges to encourage continued exploration.

What are its benefits and intended impact?

The project makes space science more accessible and engaging, especially for students who may find complex scientific information difficult to understand. It encourages curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and independent learning. Its goal is to inspire more people to explore space science and understand the achievements and challenges of space exploration.

What makes the project creative?

Instead of presenting information only as ordinary articles, Echoes of Exploration combines educational content with interactive exploration, mystery-solving, quizzes, challenges, and gamified progress tracking. This approach turns learning into an active experience.

Tools and technologies used

The website was developed using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. GitHub was used for source-code hosting and version control, while GitHub Pages was used to publish the live website. Browser local storage is used to maintain user progress.

Factors considered during development

The project was designed with ease of navigation, readable content, interactive learning, accessibility, and a student-friendly experience in mind. The website was tested in a browser and updated to improve its functionality and content.
